work.user_goal: Blind source-first Stage 0-1.6 distillation for two noncompeting valuation entrypoints with shared canonical capability cards.

known_gaps.description: TXT linearizes complex equations and some table columns imperfectly.
known_gaps.impact: Complex option formulas and long multi-stage expressions should be checked against EPUB MathML before implementation.
known_gaps.resolution: EPUB spot checks completed for core chapters; require another formula-level review at compilation.

known_gaps.description: The book contains point-in-time examples and 2024 market observations.
known_gaps.impact: Risk-free rates, ERP, betas, default spreads, multiples, tax rules and regulations cannot be reused as current inputs.
known_gaps.resolution: Runtime contracts require dated external inputs or stop with an explicit data gap.

portability_note: Local paths are redacted. Relative paths identify the supplied source edition but are not required to exist inside the deployed skill.
